rules.when: a worker runs on this runtime
rules.why: Grok renders no trust dialog for a launch, so the gate is never consulted for it. A plain Enter submits. Its composer is a bordered box whose bottom border may carry a title, which the shared shape reader recognises without a harness name. Escape only moves focus to the scrollback, so Ctrl+C is the cancel key. It leaves the composer empty, so no clear key and no arm signal are needed. A relaunch cannot resume an exact session, so it starts fresh. While a turn runs the pane renders its own footer and idle it renders a bare composer; neither is a recorded state source, so this runtime trusts no stored busy record and its live reading is owned by bin/jg-busy-lib.sh.
